newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal approves sale of 49 pct of Brisa.
newsitem.headline: Portugal approves sale of 49 pct of Brisa.

text.p: The Portuguese cabinet on Thursday approved a decree for the sale of up to 49 percent of motorway company Brisa-Autoestradas de Portugal.

As with other privatisations, part of the operation will be carried out through a direct sale to foreign and domestic institutions and part through an offer on the bourse, the cabinet's spokesman said.
But the spokesman, Vitalino Canas, said no date for the sale had yet been set and it might not be carried out this year.
"The government wants it to be this year but it is not certain that it will be," he told a news conference.
He said that the government had to guard against flooding the market with stock. Another tranche of Portugal Telecom is also due for sale in the autumn.
